newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Banco Vetor outraged over closure.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Banco Vetor outraged over closure.

text.p: Brazilian bank and brokerage Banco Vetor and Vetor Corretora said the Central Bank's decision to shut them down was an act of "indescribable violence."
The Central Bank closed down two small banks and 15 brokerage and investment houses Friday for alleged irregularities in the dealing of various types of public fixed income securities.

"Banco Vetor and Vetor Corretora have been the victims of indescribable violence," the financial institutions said in a statement. "The Central Bank did not await the conclusion of a parliamentary investigative commission which has not yet completed its work.
"It condemned without hearing the accused, causing irreparable damage to a solid institution and its more than 100 employees."
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
